title: Pearl Street Dental Partners Expands Greater Houston Presence
html:
Partnerships in Conroe, Montgomery, Houston, and Humble bring Pearl Street to 50 locations

Pearl Street Dental Partners, a Texas-based dental partnership organization, today announced partnerships with four Greater Houston practices: Conroe Comprehensive Dental Center, Montgomery Comprehensive Dental Center, Waheed Dental Professionals in Houston, and Gustafson Dental in Humble. The additions bring Pearl Street’s network to 50 locations in Texas and Oklahoma.

Under Pearl Street’s joint venture model, each owner-dentist retains an equity stake in the practice and continues to lead clinical care, with access to operational support tailored to the practice’s needs. The partnerships expand Pearl Street’s Greater Houston presence to eight locations. Bringing more practices together in the market allows regional support teams to work more closely with each office and creates opportunities to share resources, including access to specialists and staff coverage.

“We’re excited to partner with these amazing doctors to help them sustain and grow the exceptional practices they’ve created,” said David Meece, co-founder and chairman of Pearl Street. “Our role is to support the business of running a practice while dentists continue to lead patient care and retain a key stake in what they’ve built. Expanding in the Greater Houston area gives us more opportunities to deliver that support locally.”

The four partner practices serve communities across Greater Houston:

  • Conroe Comprehensive Dental Center and Montgomery Comprehensive Dental Center, led by Dr. Tim Gardner, offer general dentistry alongside oral surgery, implants, root canal therapy, cosmetic dentistry, and treatment for sleep apnea, TMJ disorders, and dental-related migraines.
  • Waheed Dental Professionals, led by Drs. Robert and Kristen Waheed, provides general and cosmetic dentistry in Houston.
  • Gustafson Dental, led by Dr. Erin Boston, offers preventive, restorative, implant, endodontic, and cosmetic care in Humble, including veneers, porcelain crowns, and professional whitening.

Founded in Dallas–Fort Worth, Pearl Street continues to focus on Texas, Oklahoma, and the Southeastern United States, pursuing partnerships with dentists who share its approach to patient care and practice ownership.

About Pearl Street Dental Partners

Pearl Street Dental Partners is a dental partnership organization based in the Dallas–Fort Worth area. Founded by David Meece and Dr. Robby Jennings, who opened their first dental practice in 1999, Pearl Street partners with growth-minded dentists through a joint venture model in which doctors keep an equity stake in their practices and choose the operational support they use, including practice management, HR, marketing, finance, accounting, call center, and revenue cycle management services. Pearl Street currently has 50 practices in Texas and Oklahoma. For more information, visit www.pearlstreetdentalpartners.com.
